description: This file defines the DisableRoleCommandHandler class which handles disabling roles by processing commands and invoking the RoleWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DisableRoleCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class annotated with @CommandType that handles disable role commands by invoking the role write platform service.

methods.name: DisableRoleCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the RoleWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to disable a role by calling the corresponding service method with the entity ID from the command.
